    $$(\mathbb{Z}/n\mathbb{Z})^\times \cong (\mathbb{Z}/p_1^{a_1}\mathbb{Z})^\times \times (\mathbb{Z}/p_2^{a_2}\mathbb{Z})^\times \times \cdots$$
